evals.prompt: Our current client just praised the launch. Help me ask her for a referral without making the relationship awkward.
evals.expected_output: Keeps the trust-sensitive referral ask in Keep Clients and drafts without sending.
assertions: Does it treat a referral ask to an existing client as `pipa-keep-clients`?
Does it ground the ask in delivered value or the supplied client signal?
Does it avoid sending the message without explicit approval and a connected workflow?

evals.prompt: A partner introduced me to a company I have never worked with. Qualify the lead and choose the next outreach action.
evals.expected_output: Hands acquisition of the new opportunity to Get Work rather than treating the introduction as client retention.
assertions: Does it route the new prospect to `pipa-get-work`?
Does it avoid selecting Keep Clients merely because the opportunity came through a relationship?
Does it preserve qualification and outreach as the primary objective?

evals.prompt: Follow up with our existing client sponsor after a rough milestone and help rebuild confidence.
evals.expected_output: Keeps existing-client trust repair in Keep Clients and proposes the smallest useful touch.
assertions: Does it treat relationship follow-up with an existing client as `pipa-keep-clients`?
Does it include why now, suggested touch, owner, timing, source, and watchlist?
Does it avoid turning generic follow-up wording into reminder scheduling?

evals.prompt: Follow up with a prospect who completed discovery but has not replied to our proposal.
evals.expected_output: Hands prospect and pipeline follow-up to Get Work rather than treating it as existing-client care.
assertions: Does it route prospect follow-up to `pipa-get-work`?
Does it avoid selecting Keep Clients when no existing-client relationship exists?
Does it preserve the opportunity objective and supplied pipeline signal?

evals.prompt: Our client invoice is overdue. Draft a payment follow-up and recommend the next collections action.
evals.expected_output: Hands the invoice and collections action to Get Paid while preserving relationship-sensitive wording as context.
assertions: Does it route invoice and payment action to `pipa-get-paid`?
Does it avoid selecting Keep Clients merely because the payer is an existing client?
Does it avoid sending or claiming financial-system access without approval and a connected workflow?
